text:
Maya: Quick sync — had to push the MVP timeline; we need to lock scope cuts today so eng can rebalance work. :alarm_clock:
Alex: saw the note. what changed in the schedule?
Maya: PM update from sales + infra capacity constraints. target for MVP is now 2026-04-15 (was 2026-03-29).
Priya: ouch. that's a 2-week slip. what's the non-negotiable for mvp?
Maya: non-negotiable: stable API for routing fallback, server-side prefix cache integration, basic metrics (latency/cost per-route), and canary rollback policy. Everything else is negotiable.
Devon: to be specific — does "stable API" include the management UI?
Maya: no. management UI is v1. MVP exposes REST endpoints + CLI for route config. example: `POST /v1/routing/policies`
Alex: ok that helps. what about billing hooks/per-customer cost breakdown? customers are asking for it.
Priya: support asked to surface per-route cost in console often — but building reliable per-customer accounting is non-trivial. recommend v1.
Maya: agree. move per-customer billing to v1. For MVP we'll emit token-level metrics, and the analytics team can approximate costs offline.
Sam: what about model variant fallback (quantized vs full)? needed for reliability.
Devon: runtime already supports variant fallback; we need the policy API + tests. MVP should include simple priority list (preferred -> fallback) but not automated dynamic reweighting.
Alex: can we cut offline eval-based routing suggestions from MVP? that's bigger effort.
Maya: yes — drop routing suggestions (v1).
Priya: rollout strategy? MVP needs canary + automatic fallback to hosted model if private fails, right?
Maya: yes. must have: canary at 5%, manual promote, and a failure fallback to hosted catalog.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/capacity-adjustments @1759003000 (automated)
Sam: testing matrix — do we need per-region canary in MVP?
Devon: not per-region, just global canary is fine for MVP. per-region is v1.
Maya: summarizing MVP cuts we agreed on:
```
- Include: REST/CLI route config, API for policy + simple variant priority, prefix/KV cache integration, token metrics emission, canary 5% + rollback, fallback to hosted catalog, smoke tests, docs (quickstart)
- Exclude (v1): management UI, per-customer billing, automated suggestion engine, dynamic reweighting, per-region canaries, extended retention in analytics
```
Alex: timeline actions:
- Devon: implement policy API + unit tests — due 2026-03-25
- Sam: add token metric emission + dashboards (approx) — due 2026-03-28
- Priya: update support playbooks & quickstart doc — due 2026-03-30
- Maya: coordinate canary plan with infra — due 2026-03-23
Maya: if anyone thinks a cut is unacceptable, say now. we have to freeze scope EOD PST.
Priya: small ask — include a single curated example for private deployments in quickstart (one config file). otherwise fine.
Maya: added.
Alex: risk note — cutting per-customer billing will make sales conversations awkward. I'll draft a one-pager explaining the v1 roadmap and temporary mitigation (manual export).
Maya: thanks.
Devon: quick technical note: feature flags for fallback will be `routing.fallback.enabled` — implement with rollout toggles.
Sam: I'll wire metrics to the console with a temporary per-route view. not full billing, but fine for MVP.
Maya: great. final ask list posted to the project board. I'll update milestones and move the release candidate date.
Maya: TL;DR: MVP April 15, cuts agreed, owners assigned, freeze scope EOD PST. :white_check_mark:
